title: Integrated Information
description: A mind is more than its parts: a network is conscious, on one theory, to the degree that it is both integrated (every part affects every other) and differentiated (its parts do different things). Integrated information Φ is low for a crystal, where everything does the same, and low for a heap of separate parts; it peaks between. Unlocks the Connectome Array, Engrams, and a cheaper Superintelligence Core.

puzzle.goal: A toy network of n units, each joined to the rest with probability p. Its integration grows as 1 − e^(−n·p) and its differentiation falls as e^(−p·n/10). Write the toy Φ as their product times n.
puzzle.name: A toy Φ
puzzle.ask: Find Φ for n = @{n} units joined with p = @{p}.
puzzle.method: Each factor alone is a monotone curve; their product is a hump: Φ is largest for a sparse but connected net.
